data.summary: This single‑week plan focuses on intensive review of all AP Calculus AB units, with special emphasis on the student’s weak area—Unit 4 Contextual Applications of Differentiation. The schedule balances conceptual understanding, problem practice, and timed review within the 12‑hour limit.

weeks.focus: Intensive mixed‑topic review with emphasis on Unit 4.
tasks: Do 20 limit problems covering 1.1–1.2 and mark solutions;
Solve 15 derivative problems from 2.1 and 3.1, noting chain rule use;
Complete 10 related‑rates problems from 4.1, checking reasoning;
Apply the Mean Value Theorem to 5 sample functions;
Work through 8 Riemann sum approximations for 6.1;
Sketch and analyze 5 slope fields for 7.1;
Compute average values for 3 functions in 8.1;
Take a 60‑minute timed practice test covering all units;
Review errors and summarize key concepts in a 500‑word reflection.

data.final_week_advice: Use the remaining time after the timed test to focus on any weak spots identified, especially in Unit 4, and to consolidate understanding of the Mean Value Theorem and Riemann sums before the exam.
